'''Sharon B. Emerson''' (born 1945) is an American [[biologist]] and was a research professor emeritus at the [[University of Utah]].

In 1993, she was chair of the Division of Vertebrate Morphology of the [[American Society of Zoologists]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.chron.com/CDA/archives/archive.mpl/1995_1280028/2-texans-among-list-of-winners-of-macarthur-grants.html |title=2 Texans among list of winners of MacArthur grants |website=www.chron.com |access-date=14 January 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121018230319/http://www.chron.com/CDA/archives/archive.mpl/1995_1280028/2-texans-among-list-of-winners-of-macarthur-grants.html |archive-date=18 October 2012 |url-status=dead|date=1995-06-13}}</ref>
She taught at [[University of Illinois, Chicago]].<ref>{{cite web |title=UIC Gender & Women's Studies |url=http://www.uic.edu/depts/wsweb/program/history.htm |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100528044116/http://www.uic.edu/depts/wsweb/program/history.htm |archive-date=2010-05-28 |accessdate=25 October 2018 |website=Uic.edu}}</ref>
